COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLR No. 640 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Naman Kamboj, learned counsel for the Revisionists. 
2. Mr. G. C. Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State. 
3. The present criminal revision under Section 438/442 of 
BNSS is moved on behalf of the Revisionists to set-aside the 
impugned judgment dated 08.09.2025 passed by learned 3rd
Additional Session Judge, Haridwar in Criminal Appeal No.89 of 
2025, titled as “Avdesh Kumar Garg & Anr. Vs. Smt. Manjari & 
others” and the judgment dated 09.12.2024 passed by learned 
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haridwar in Misc. Criminal 
Case No.1934 of 2024, titled as “Manjari Agarwal vs. Avdesh 
Kumar Garg & Others” and thereby delete/set-aside the 
revisionists, being father-in-law and mother-in-law, as array of 
parties in proceedings under Protection of Women from 
Domestic Violence Act, 2005 pending before the learned 
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haridwar.
4. Heard. 
5. Admit. 
6. Issue notice to the private Respondents, returnable within 
two weeks. Steps to be taken within one week.
7. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a 
period of three weeks.
8. List this matter on 17.12.2025.
9. Further proceedings of Misc. Criminal Case No.1934 of 
2024, titled as “Manjari Agarwal vs. Avdesh Kumar Garg &  Others” pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial 
Magistrate, Haridwar, qua the Revisionists shall remain stayed 
till the next date of listing. 
10. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2025) stands disposed of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 15.10.2025
Akash
